'''Echo''' is an uncommon [[Riggs]] card.

==Description==

[[File:CardEcho.png|frameless|118px|left|top]]
Costs 1 energy. When played: 
:1. Put a card from your discard pile on top of your deck.
<br clear=all>

==Upgrades==

===Echo A===

[[File:CardEchoA.png|frameless|118px|left|top]]
Costs '''0''' energy. When played: 
:1. Put a card from your discard pile on top of your deck.
<br clear=all>


===Echo B===

[[File:CardEchoB.png|frameless|118px|left|top]]
Costs 1 energy. When played: 
:1. Put a card from your discard pile '''in your hand'''.
<br clear=all>

==Strategy==
Echo allows you to recur cards, setting them up for next turn, but at a rather high cost. Note that Echo, when played, slows down your card draw by 2 (drawing it, and the recurred card), and costs Energy for an effect that generally doesn't help you this turn (unless you have card draw; but you'd need to afford this card, the card draw, and the target to play it this turn). It can help set up combos for next turn, such as [[Juke]] and [[Strafe]], but isn't a super reliable way to do that. It can put [[Charge Beam]] on top of the deck, in some cases letting you charge it faster; again, this is quite situational. This card suffers quite badly in comparison to [[Selective Memory]], admittedly a rare card. It is just generally too slow and unreliable to be worth it most of the time.

Its A upgrade makes it 0 cost, helping you use it in conjunction with other cards such as card draw. A good upgrade on a not-so-good card.

Its B upgrade essentially adds a draw 1 effect to it, which when you put it that way isn't a great upgrade in comparison to e.g. [[Options]]'s B upgrade. Since Echo is one of the cards in your hand when you draw it, it's hard to believe this will help you line up combos most of the time.
